metaDescription: Source plastic shell steel blade tape measures for retail and hardware programs. Review blade scale, shell color, custom logo, packaging, barcode and QC requirements.
introduction: WOOKTOOL plastic shell steel blade tape measures give hardware, retail and private-label buyers a practical format for value and mid-range measuring-tool programs. Buyers can specify blade unit, shell color, logo and packaging around their target channel.

For a quote, send the preferred length, scale format, quantity, target market, logo file and packaging reference. The factory can then review sample direction, product function and pre-shipment inspection points.

faq.question: Can the plastic shell color be customized?
faq.answer: Shell color and logo treatment can be reviewed for OEM and private-label orders.

faq.question: Which scale options are available?
faq.answer: Metric, imperial or dual-scale requirements should be confirmed with the selected model and target market.

faq.question: What quality checks matter?
faq.answer: Typical checks cover blade readability, retraction, lock function, hook rivet, case assembly and finished packaging.

faq.question: Can retail packaging be supplied?
faq.answer: Yes. Buyers can discuss blister cards, color boxes, barcode labels and carton marks.
